_chapters.第二章 网络安全支持与促进: Chapter II  Support for and Promotion of Cybersecurity
_chapters.第二节 关键信息基础设施的运行安全: Section 2  Operation Security of Critical Information Infrastructure
_chapters.第五章 监测预警与应急处置: Chapter V  Monitoring, Early Warning and Emergency Response

第一条: Article 1  This Law is formulated in order to safeguard cybersecurity, to protect sovereignty in cyberspace and national security and the public interest, to protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons and other organisations, and to promote the healthy development of economic and social informatisation.
第二条: Article 2  This Law applies to the construction, operation, maintenance and use of networks within the territory of the People’s Republic of China, and to the supervision and administration of cybersecurity.
第三条: Article 3  Cybersecurity work adheres to the leadership of the Communist Party of China, implements the overall national security concept, coordinates development and security, and advances the building of a strong cyber nation.
第四条: Article 4  The State attaches equal importance to cybersecurity and to the development of informatisation; following the policy of active use, scientific development, administration according to law and assured security, it advances the construction and interconnection of network infrastructure, encourages innovation and application in network technology, supports the training of cybersecurity personnel, establishes and improves a cybersecurity assurance system, and raises the capacity to protect cybersecurity.
第五条: Article 5  The State shall formulate and continuously improve a cybersecurity strategy, specifying the basic requirements and principal objectives for safeguarding cybersecurity and setting out cybersecurity policies, tasks and measures for key areas.
第六条: Article 6  The State shall take measures to monitor, defend against and handle cybersecurity risks and threats originating within and outside the territory of the People’s Republic of China, to protect critical information infrastructure from attack, intrusion, interference and destruction, to punish unlawful and criminal activity involving networks in accordance with law, and to maintain security and order in cyberspace.
第七条: Article 7  The State advocates honest, trustworthy, healthy and civilised online conduct, promotes the dissemination of core socialist values, takes measures to raise society-wide cybersecurity awareness and capability, and fosters a sound environment in which the whole of society participates in promoting cybersecurity.
第八条: Article 8  The State shall actively conduct international exchange and cooperation in cyberspace governance, network technology research and development, standard-setting and combating unlawful and criminal activity involving networks; it shall promote the construction of a peaceful, secure, open and cooperative cyberspace and the establishment of a multilateral, democratic and transparent system of network governance.
第九条:
Article 9  The national cyberspace administration department is responsible for the overall coordination of cybersecurity work and the related supervision and administration. The telecommunications department of the State Council, the public security department and other relevant authorities are responsible, within the scope of their respective duties, for cybersecurity protection, supervision and administration in accordance with this Law and the relevant laws and administrative regulations.

The cybersecurity protection, supervision and administration duties of the relevant departments of local people’s governments at or above the county level shall be determined in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State.
第十条: Article 10  In conducting business and service activities, a network operator must comply with laws and administrative regulations, respect social morality, observe commercial ethics, act in good faith, perform its cybersecurity protection obligations, submit to supervision by the government and by society, and bear social responsibility.
第十一条: Article 11  Those who construct or operate networks, or who provide services through networks, shall, in accordance with laws and administrative regulations and the mandatory requirements of national standards, adopt technical and other necessary measures to ensure the secure and stable operation of the network, to respond effectively to cybersecurity incidents, to guard against unlawful and criminal activity involving networks, and to maintain the integrity, confidentiality and availability of network data.
第十二条: Article 12  Network-related industry organisations shall, in accordance with their articles of association, strengthen industry self-regulation, formulate codes of conduct for cybersecurity, guide their members in strengthening cybersecurity protection, raise the level of cybersecurity protection, and promote the healthy development of the industry.
第十三条:
Article 13  The State protects the right of citizens, legal persons and other organisations to use networks in accordance with law, promotes the spread of network access, raises the level of network services, provides society with secure and convenient network services, and ensures that network information flows freely in an orderly manner in accordance with law.

Individuals and organisations using networks shall comply with the Constitution and the law, observe public order and respect social morality; they may not endanger cybersecurity, and may not use networks to engage in activities endangering national security, honour or interests, inciting subversion of state power or the overthrow of the socialist system, inciting separatism or undermining national unity, propagating terrorism or extremism, propagating ethnic hatred or ethnic discrimination, disseminating violent or obscene and pornographic information, fabricating or disseminating false information so as to disrupt economic and social order, or infringing the reputation, privacy, intellectual property or other lawful rights and interests of others.
第十四条: Article 14  The State supports research into and development of network products and services conducive to the healthy growth of minors, punishes in accordance with law the use of networks to engage in activities harmful to the physical and mental health of minors, and provides minors with a secure and healthy network environment.
第十五条:
Article 15  Any individual or organisation has the right to report conduct endangering cybersecurity to the cyberspace administration, telecommunications, public security or other departments. The department receiving a report shall deal with it promptly in accordance with law; where the matter does not fall within that department’s duties, it shall promptly transfer it to the department with the power to deal with it.

The relevant departments shall keep confidential the information of the person making the report and protect their lawful rights and interests.
